archived_todos.title: Blog post pages: check if Review schema is correctly applied
archived_todos.how_to: Audit /blog/* pages for Review JSON-LD. Blog reviews should also use reviewRating only (single editorial review), not aggregateRating.

archived_todos.title: 错开GitHub Actions cron整点时间
archived_todos.how_to: 把gsc-fetch、context-update、uptime-monitor三个workflow的cron从整点改成错开5-10分钟（如01,31分），避免GitHub高峰丢弃任务
archived_todos.source: GitHub官方docs: scheduled workflows delayed at top of hour

archived_todos.title: 给Next.js构建workflow加缓存
archived_todos.how_to: actions/setup-node加cache:npm，再加actions/cache缓存.next/cache目录，key用runner.os+lockfile hash

archived_todos.title: 检查GitHub Secrets是否单独存储
archived_todos.how_to: 确认GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON等每个敏感值单独建Secret，不要拼JSON blob；确认Secret Scanning和Push Protection已开启

archived_todos.title: 给所有workflow加workflow_dispatch手动触发
archived_todos.how_to: 每个workflow文件on字段加workflow_dispatch，修复后可在Actions页面手动触发不用等cron

archived_todos.title: Use setup-node cache:'npm' instead of manual actions/cache for deps
archived_todos.how_to: In new workflows, prefer actions/setup-node with cache:'npm' (auto-handles ~/.npm). Only use manual actions/cache for .next/cache build output. restore-keys with prefix for partial fallback.

archived_todos.title: Verify layout.tsx uses next/font self-hosted, not external Google Fonts link
archived_todos.how_to: Check app/layout.tsx. If it uses <link> to fonts.googleapis.com, replace with next/font/google (e.g. Inter/Geist). Specify subsets:['latin'], display:'swap'. Eliminates external DNS lookup and FOUT.

archived_todos.title: Audit Article schema on 105 blog posts: add dateModified, author Organization, 1920x1080 image
archived_todos.description: Google Article schema recommended fields: headline, image (ImageObject min 1920x1080), datePublished, dateModified, author (Person/Organization), publisher. Batch check data/posts.json: ensure every post has updatedAt -> dateModified, author = AIToolCrux Research Team Organization, coverImage dimensions >= 1920x1080.

archived_todos.title: FAQPage schema: keep for AI/GEO, do not optimize for Google rich stars
archived_todos.description: Google FAQ rich results deprecated 2026-05-07, Rich Results Test FAQ support removed 2026-06, Search Console API FAQ support removed 2026-08. Keep FAQPage JSON-LD (helps Perplexity/ChatGPT answer extraction) but stop treating FAQ as a Google rich snippet lever. Ignore GSC FAQ warnings.

archived_todos.title: Audit BreadcrumbList JSON-LD structure: position starts at 1, name, item URL
archived_todos.description: Spot-check 10 tool pages: BreadcrumbList should be ItemList of ListElement items with position (1,2,3...), name, item (absolute URL). Fix any flat ItemList or missing position fields.

archived_todos.title: Preload LCP element with fetchpriority=high
archived_todos.description: Use Chrome DevTools Performance panel to identify LCP element on homepage and top blog posts. If it's a hero image, add <link rel=preload as=image fetchpriority=high> in head. Target TTFB < 400ms, LCP < 2.5s.

archived_todos.title: Audit raw tags for missing width/height
archived_todos.description: next/image auto-reserves aspect-ratio. But any raw in custom components must have width/height attributes or CSS aspect-ratio. Also check cookie banners / ad slots above fold have reserved min-height. Target CLS < 0.1.

archived_todos.title: Debounce high-frequency event handlers; yield in long loops
archived_todos.description: Audit scroll/resize/input/keydown handlers in tool list, search, pagination. Add debounce/throttle. In heavy map/filter loops, insert await scheduler.yield() (or yieldToMain polyfill) to let browser paint. Target INP < 200ms.

archived_todos.title: Measure TTFB on key pages via PageSpeed Insights
archived_todos.description: SSG on Vercel should have TTFB < 200ms. Run PSI on /, /ranking, /compare, /tools/chatgpt. If TTFB > 400ms, check Vercel edge cache and Cache-Control headers. TTFB slow = all LCP optimizations capped.

archived_todos.title: Audit all .github/workflows/*.yml: declare explicit permissions per job
archived_todos.description: Every workflow should set `permissions: contents: read` at top, then elevate per-job (e.g. issues: write, pull-requests: write). Repo-level default should be read-only. Source: GitHub secure-use docs.

archived_todos.title: Pin all third-party actions to full commit SHA; add Dependabot
archived_todos.description: Replace `uses: owner/action@v5` with full 40-char commit SHA. Add .github/dependabot.yml with package-ecosystem: github-actions to auto-PR upgrades. Trivy supply-chain event proved tags are mutable.

archived_todos.title: Audit workflows for shell injection via github.event context
archived_todos.description: Find any `run: echo ${{ github.event.* }}` patterns. Move to env: block and reference $ENV_VAR in shell. Especially check issue-comment / PR-triggered workflows.

archived_todos.title: Add concurrency block to scheduled workflows
archived_todos.description: Add `concurrency: { group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: false }` to gsc-fetch, context-update, uptime-monitor to prevent overlapping runs wasting minutes.

archived_todos.title: Verify scheduled cron times use Asia/Shanghai timezone
archived_todos.description: GitHub Actions now supports top-level `timezone: Asia/Shanghai`. Audit cron expressions: if they were written assuming UTC, add timezone field or recalculate. Also verify workflows exist on default branch (main) or they won't run.

archived_todos.title: Audit public/llms.txt: H1 + blockquote + H2 sections + markdown links
archived_todos.description: Per llms.txt spec: first line `# Site Name`, then `> one-line description`, then `## Category` sections each with `- [text](url)` links. List top reviews, compare pages, blog posts, category pages. Source: llmstxt.studio.

archived_todos.title: Explicitly allow AI search crawlers in robots.txt
archived_todos.description: Add User-agent blocks for OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Claude-User with Allow: /. Keep training bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot) allowed too — being in training data helps. Source: capston.ai + landkit.pro.

archived_todos.title: Add ## FAQ section (3-5 Q&A pairs) to every blog post
archived_todos.description: Perplexity and Claude directly extract explicit Q&A pairs. Use `## FAQ` then `### Q: ...` followed by direct answer sentence. Improves AI citation rate. Source: crawlraven + linksurge.jp.

archived_todos.title: Inject concrete numbers and inline source citations in blog posts
archived_todos.description: GEO research: adding specific numbers/percentages/dates boosts visibility +40%; adding inline source citations boosts +115% for mid-ranked pages. Add pricing, monthly visit estimates, accuracy percentages, and link to original sources. Source: aithinkerlab GEO 2026.

archived_todos.title: Consider adding public/llms-full.txt for full content index
archived_todos.description: llms.txt is curated summary; llms-full.txt is full content for AI crawlers. For a 533-tool directory, generate a full index listing all tool pages + blog posts with one-line descriptions. Source: llms-txt-generator.de 2026.

archived_todos.title: Add 'May earn commission' disclosure near every tool page CTA (incentivized review disclosure rule).
Migrate tool page screenshots to next/image with correct sizes prop. List cards: sizes='(max-width:768px) 100vw, 400px'. Detail hero: sizes='(max-width:768px) 100vw, 800px'. Only hero gets priority.
Use URL Inspection API to sample 50 key URLs (homepage + 10 tools + 10 posts + 10 categories). Stay under 2000 QPD quota. Don't crawl all 700.
IndexNow only on new/updated content; don't resubmit unchanged URLs. Verify root has <key>.txt file.
Do NOT use Google Indexing API for regular blog posts (off-label, JobPosting/BroadcastEvent only). Rely on internal links + sitemap + time.
Add timeout-minutes: 5 to uptime-monitor.yml and timeout-minutes: 30 to index-monitor.yml. Default 360min is too long.
archived_todos.note: Added timeout-minutes to all 5 workflows: gsc-fetch=15, context-update=15, uptime-monitor=5, index-monitor=30, seo-check=15.

archived_todos.title: Use setup-node@v4 cache: 'npm' instead of manual actions/cache@v4. Simplify workflow YAML.
Set timezone: 'Asia/Shanghai' on all on.schedule triggers so cron reads in local time, not UTC.
Audit all tags missing width/height; add dimensions. next/image migration auto-resolves this.
Check cookie banner / notification bar: if it dynamically inserts above existing content and pushes it down, change to fixed-height placeholder or position:fixed floating.
接入 Vercel Speed Insights（@vercel/speed-insights）
archived_todos.why: 官方 RUM，免费 10k events/月，分路由/分地区/分设备看 LCP/INP/CLS，RES 综合分。和现有 web-vitals→GA4 并存。
archived_todos.how: npm i @vercel/speed-insights；在 app/layout.tsx 加 <SpeedInsights sampleRate={0.2} />；部署后看 Vercel 控制台 /tools/* 页面 LCP 中位数。

archived_todos.title: 工具详情页 OG 图改用 app/tools/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx + ImageResponse
archived_todos.why: Next.js 官方文件约定，build 时 SSG 成静态 PNG，比现在 /api/og?title=...（运行时重定向）更快更稳。
archived_todos.how: 新建 opengraph-image.tsx，用 next/og ImageResponse 渲染工具名+评分；metadata 里删掉手动 openGraph.images。

archived_todos.title: 拆分 GSC 查询为周趋势 + 月 query 报告
archived_todos.why: 现有 GSC 抓取脚本单一查询；按官方最佳实践拆 dimensions=[page] 周环比 + dimensions=[query,page] 月高曝光低 CTR 报告。
archived_todos.how: 在现有 GSC Data Fetch workflow 里加两个 query：(1) 周一跑 page 维度 rowLimit=25000；(2) 月一跑 query+page 维度找 CTR<2% 但 impressions>100 的页面。注意 aggregationType=byPage、normalize trailing slash、数据延迟 2-3 天。

archived_todos.title: 拆分 sitemap：根 sitemap + app/tools/sitemap.ts + app/blog/sitemap.ts
archived_todos.why: 现在单 sitemap 随 533 工具+文章增长会超 50k URL/单 sitemap 限制；Next.js 文件约定自动索引子 sitemap。
archived_todos.how: 把现有 app/sitemap.ts 拆成：根 sitemap.ts 列子 sitemap URL；app/tools/sitemap.ts 列全部工具页；app/blog/sitemap.ts 列全部文章页。用 MetadataRoute.Sitemap 类型。

archived_todos.title: 把 public/robots.txt 迁成 app/robots.ts
archived_todos.why: Next.js 文件约定自动生成 /robots.txt，可动态读站点 URL，不用硬编码域名；和 sitemap.ts 配合。
archived_todos.how: 新建 app/robots.ts，export default function robots() 返回 { rules: [...], sitemap: 'https://www.aitoolcrux.com/sitemap.xml', host: '...' }；删 public/robots.txt。

archived_todos.title: 给工具页/文章页加 loading.tsx 骨架屏 + error.tsx 错误边界
archived_todos.why: Next.js streaming 核心：loading.tsx 自动包 Suspense，静态 shell 先发给浏览器，提升 LCP 感知；error.tsx 捕获渲染错误。
archived_todos.how: app/tools/[slug]/loading.tsx 写工具详情骨架屏；app/tools/[slug]/error.tsx 写 'use client' 错误页带 reset 按钮；app/blog/[slug]/ 同理。注意 loading/error 必须 'use client'。

archived_todos.title: 检查 notFound() 调用位置，确保不存在页面返回真 404 状态码
archived_todos.why: Next.js streaming 陷阱：mid-stream notFound 只能替换内容，HTTP 状态仍是 200，SEO 上等于软 404。必须在数据函数里提前判断。
archived_todos.how: grep 所有 notFound() 调用；如果在 page 顶层或被 Suspense 包的组件里，移到数据获取函数里（如 getToolBySlug 不存在时直接 notFound()）；用 curl -I 验证不存在的 /tools/xxx 返回 404。

archived_todos.title: 给工具页/文章页加 ISR 缓存（revalidate=86400）
archived_todos.why: 现在工具页每次请求都读 JSON，加 24h ISR 后 CDN 缓存，响应时间从 3000ms 降到 <100ms；数据改了用 revalidateTag 后台刷新。
archived_todos.how: app/tools/[slug]/page.tsx 加 export const revalidate = 86400；fetch 工具数据时打 next: { tags: ['tools'] }；后台改数据后调 revalidateTag('tools')。

archived_todos.title: 审计所有 fetch 调用，显式标注缓存策略
archived_todos.why: App Router fetch 默认永久缓存，可能导致数据不更新；实时数据要 cache: 'no-store'，静态数据要 next.revalidate。
archived_todos.how: grep 所有 fetch( 调用；工具列表/文章列表加 next: { revalidate: 86400 }；实时数据（如 Product Hunt 新品）加 cache: 'no-store'。

archived_todos.title: Audit alternates.canonical uses absolute URL on all tool/blog/compare pages
archived_todos.how_to: Grep generateMetadata in app/tools/[slug], app/blog/[slug], app/compare/[slug]. Ensure alternates.canonical is absolute URL (https://www.aitoolcrux.com/...), not relative. Google requires absolute URLs.

archived_todos.title: Add lastModified to sitemap.ts entries
archived_todos.how_to: Check app/sitemap.ts. Add lastModified field (from data/tools.json updatedAt or posts.json date) to each URL entry. Improves GSC freshness signals.

archived_todos.title: Add googleBot max-image-preview=large to root metadata
archived_todos.how_to: Check app/layout.tsx metadata. Add robots.googleBot: { 'max-image-preview': 'large', 'max-snippet': -1, 'max-video-preview': -1 }. Enables large image rich snippets in Google Search.

archived_todos.title: Audit BreadcrumbSchema on all tool/blog/compare pages: position starts at 1, item is absolute URL
archived_todos.how_to: Grep where BreadcrumbSchema is used. Verify: (1) position starts at 1 and increments by 1; (2) item URL is absolute (https://www.aitoolcrux.com/...); (3) breadcrumb matches visible breadcrumb on page. Fix any relative URLs or off-by-one positions.

archived_todos.title: Optimize FAQSchema answer text for AI search: 40-120 words, direct answer in first sentence
archived_todos.how_to: Audit FAQ data in data/posts.json or wherever faqs come from. Ensure each acceptedAnswer.text is 40-120 words and the first sentence directly answers the question. This improves AI Overview / Perplexity extraction even though Google retired FAQ rich snippets for non-authority sites.

archived_todos.title: Run Google Rich Results Test on 5 tool pages + 3 blog pages to validate Breadcrumb + FAQ schema
archived_todos.how_to: Use https://search.google.com/test/rich-results on /tools/midjourney, /tools/chatgpt, /tools/cursor, /tools/perplexity, /tools/elevenlabs + 3 blog posts. Confirm no errors/warnings for BreadcrumbList and FAQPage. Fix any issues found.

archived_todos.title: Add CSP header allowing AdSense Google domains (pagead2.googlesyndication.com, doubleclick.net)
archived_todos.description: After AdSense is live, add Content-Security-Policy in next.config.mjs headers. script-src must include https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com and https://googleads.g.doubleclick.net. img-src include https://*.googleusercontent.com. frame-src include googleads.g.doubleclick.net. Start with Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only for 1 week to catch violations without breaking ads.

archived_todos.title: Add weekly linkinator dead-link scan workflow for all tool pages
archived_todos.description: Add .github/workflows/deadlink-check.yml running weekly (Monday 06:00 UTC). Use npx linkinator https://www.aitoolcrux.com --recurse --timeout 10000 --retry --skip 'twitter.com|linkedin.com|facebook.com' (social media often blocks bots). Output broken links list as artifact. Focus on affiliate outbound links in tool pages (broken affiliate link = lost revenue).

archived_todos.title: Run Unlighthouse full-site scan once, identify 10 worst-performing pages
archived_todos.description: Run npx unlighthouse --site https://www.aitoolcrux.com --output-path ./unlighthouse-report. It will crawl all pages and run Lighthouse on each. Identify the 10 pages with lowest performance score (focus on tool pages since there are 533). Record the list in iteration_center/ for prioritized optimization. This is a one-time scan (not CI), can be run locally.

archived_todos.title: Audit tsconfig.json strict mode and enable noImplicitAny + strictNullChecks
archived_todos.description: Read tsconfig.json, check if strict:true is enabled. If not, first enable noImplicitAny and strictNullChecks (the two most impactful), run npx tsc --noEmit, fix all errors, then enable remaining strict sub-options one by one. Goal: full strict mode with 0 errors.

archived_todos.title: Run @next/bundle-analyzer to identify largest client chunks and replace heavy libraries
archived_todos.description: Install @next/bundle-analyzer, configure in next.config.mjs, run ANALYZE=true npm run build. Generate treemap report. Identify the 3 largest client-side chunks. Check for heavy libraries that can be replaced: moment.js->dayjs, lodash->lodash-es/es-toolkit, axios->native fetch. Record findings in iteration_center/. This is a read-only analysis task (no code changes needed unless replacements are obvious).

archived_todos.title: Audit heavy Client Components for next/dynamic lazy loading or Server Component conversion
archived_todos.description: Search app/ and components/ for 'use client' files. Identify heavy components (chart libraries, rich text editors, code editors, maps) that are loaded on initial page render but could be: (a) converted to Server Component if no interactivity needed, or (b) wrapped in next/dynamic with ssr:false and a loading fallback. Focus on components used in tool detail pages and blog articles. Priority: components >50KB gzipped.

archived_todos.title: 检查 Cloudflare WAF 是否误拦 AI 爬虫
archived_todos.description: 检查 Cloudflare WAF 规则是否拦截 GPTBot/ChatGPT-User/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/Google-Extended/OAI-AdsBot。ChatGPT-User 自2025年12月起不尊重 robots.txt，必须靠 WAF 放行。用户明确要求放开 AI 爬虫限制。

archived_todos.title: robots.txt 显式列出所有 AI 爬虫并 Allow
archived_todos.description: 在 public/robots.txt 中显式列出 GPTBot/OAI-SearchBot/ChatGPT-User/ClaudeBot/Claude-SearchBot/PerplexityBot/Google-Extended/Applebot-Extended/OAI-AdsBot 并 Allow: /，替代当前的 User-agent: * 通配。便于后续单独控制某个 AI 爬虫。

archived_todos.title: 生成 public/llms.txt 文件
archived_todos.description: 生成 llms.txt v2 格式文件，列出所有工具页和博客文章的 URL。Google 不使用但 Perplexity/Claude agent 会参考，帮助 AI 更高效爬取。低成本高收益。

archived_todos.title: 用 GSC Search Analytics API + GitHub Actions 自动化拉取每周数据
archived_todos.description: 用 Google Search Console API 程序化拉取搜索分析数据（点击/曝光/CTR/排名/查询/页面），通过 GitHub Actions 每周定时运行，输出到 CSV/JSON。替代手动从 GSC 下载。

archived_todos.title: 给高流量文章加 Quick Answer 段落提升 AI Overviews 引用率
archived_todos.description: 给 GSC 中曝光量 Top 20 的博客文章在开头加 Quick Answer/TL;DR 段落（2-3句话直接回答标题问题）。AI Overviews 最喜欢引用这种格式。配合已有 FAQPage 结构化数据。

archived_todos.title: 审计页面是否意外变成动态渲染
archived_todos.description: 检查所有 page.tsx/layout.tsx 是否使用了 cookies()/headers()/searchParams/未缓存 fetch 导致全页失去 SSG 变成动态渲染。纯静态站最常见的性能回退。用 grep 搜索这些 API，确认每个使用都有合理理由。

archived_todos.title: 工具页重型组件用 next/dynamic 懒加载
archived_todos.description: 工具详情页的重型组件（大 JSON 数据渲染、对比表格、FAQ 展开组件）用 next/dynamic({ ssr: false }) 懒加载，减少首屏 JS 体积，改善 INP。配合 P2-BUNDLE-ANALYZE-001 先分析包体积。

archived_todos.title: 规划升级到 Next.js 16 兼容性评估
archived_todos.description: 评估从 Next.js 14.2.5 升级到 16 的兼容性：React 19 变更（use() hook、use cache 指令）、缓存模型变更（fetch cache 默认行为变化）、PPR 稳定版、Turbopack 默认。先做依赖兼容性检查（next-themes、react-icons 等），输出升级风险报告，不直接升级。

archived_todos.title: 审计所有图片是否用 next/image + priority + width/height
archived_todos.description: 全站审计：(a) 工具详情页主截图是否用 next/image + priority（LCP 元素，不加 priority LCP 延迟 200-500ms）；(b) 文章截图是否用 next/image（而非原始 img）；(c) 远程图片是否配置 remotePatterns；(d) 图片是否缺 width/height 导致 CLS；(e) LCP 图片是否加了 sizes 属性。用 grep 搜索

archived_todos.title: 审计字体是否通过 next/font 加载
archived_todos.description: 检查 app/layout.tsx 和全局 CSS：(a) 字体是否通过 next/font/google 或 next/font/local 加载（构建时自托管，零外部请求）；(b) 是否有 CSS @import url('fonts.googleapis.com') 或 <link href=Google Fonts>（绕过自托管，导致额外 DNS+TCP 请求 + CLS）；(c) font display 策略是否合理（LCP 文本用 optional，品牌字体用 swap）。

archived_todos.title: 启用 AVIF 图片格式减少体积
archived_todos.description: 在 next.config.mjs 中 images.formats: ['image/avif', 'image/webp'] 启用 AVIF。AVIF 比 WebP 小 20-50%（对照片类工具截图效果明显），2026 年浏览器覆盖率 >95%。Vercel Edge 缓存首次编码后无性能影响。注意监控 Vercel Image Optimization 配额（Hobby 1000次/月）。

archived_todos.title: GSC URL Inspection API 全量检查页面索引状态
archived_todos.description: 用 GSC URL Inspection API（POST https://searchconsole.googleapis.com/v1/urlInspection/index:inspect）全量检查 ~700 页面（533工具+105文章+分类+对比页）的索引状态。输出：未索引页面清单（verdict=FAIL）、原因（pageFetchState/robotsTxtState/indexingState/referringUrls）、索引覆盖率。OAuth 服务账号认证（GSC 添加服务账号邮箱为完整权限）。每天配额 2000 次足够。结果写入 iteration_center/gsc-reports/。

archived_todos.title: 清理 sitemap 中的 noindex 页面
archived_todos.description: sitemap 应只包含可索引（indexable）的 200 页面，不包含 noindex 页面（Google 官方明确说 noindex 页面在 sitemap 中会混淆信号、浪费抓取配额）。我们项目 156 个 /blog/tag/* 薄内容页已加 noindex,follow（OpenSEO 审计修复），必须从 app/sitemap.ts 生成的 sitemap 中移除这些页面。同时检查是否有 301/404 页面残留在 sitemap 中。

archived_todos.title: 验证 IndexNow key 文件并配置自动提交
